findings.current: Not a single internal organ remained undamaged, and the acupoints that should have been broad and sturdy in a Peak master had collapsed like the walls of a dilapidated house.
findings.defect: Acupoints cannot be broad or collapse like walls; here 혈도 refers collectively to the body's internal qi pathways, not individual points.
findings.rationale: The descriptions 넓고 튼튼해야 할 and 허물어져 있었다 characterize extended pathways capable of being broad, sturdy, and structurally ruined.
findings.replacement: Not a single internal organ remained undamaged, and the qi pathways that should have been broad and sturdy in a Peak master had collapsed like the walls of a dilapidated house.
findings.source: 내장기관은 상하지 않은 곳이 없었고, 절정 고수답게 넓고 튼튼해야 할 혈도는 낡은 폐가의 담벼락처럼 허물어져 있었다.

findings.current: They had wanted to speak. They simply had not been able to.
findings.defect: The draft turns a conditional statement into a factual assertion that the men wanted to speak.
findings.rationale: 하고 싶어도 means “even if they wanted to,” preserving uncertainty about their desire while stressing their physical inability.
findings.replacement: No. Even if they had wanted to speak, they couldn't.
findings.source: 아니, 하고 싶어도 하지 못했던 거다.

findings.current: “Hmm. The others are the same. The cut surfaces on their tongues have healed, so it seems they took care of this a long time ago.”
findings.defect: The draft assigns the mutilation to the masked men themselves, while the Korean leaves whoever took the measure unspecified.
findings.rationale: 조치를 취해 놓은 모양이야 does not identify an agent; retaining the passive avoids adding responsibility that the scene has not established.
findings.replacement: “Hmm. The others are the same. Judging by how the severed ends of their tongues have healed, it looks like this was done a long time ago.”
findings.source: “음, 다른 놈들도 마찬가지다. 혀의 단면이 아물어 있는 것을 보아하니, 이미 오래전에 조치를 취해 놓은 모양이야.”

findings.current: On top of that, the true mastermind behind today's attack was connected to those two words: Dark Heaven.
findings.defect: “Was connected to” weakens Jin’s conclusion from Dark Heaven being the true force behind the attack to a vague association.
findings.rationale: 진정한 배후에는 암천이라는 두 글자가 있었다 directly places Dark Heaven behind the attack rather than merely connecting the mastermind to it.
findings.replacement: On top of that, the true force behind today's attack could be summed up in two words: Dark Heaven.
findings.source: 게다가 오늘의 습격의 진정한 배후에는 암천이라는 두 글자가 있었다.

findings.current: I can tell just from the fact that they severed their heart meridians instead of taking poison.
findings.defect: The draft generalizes 독단, a poison pill, to poison of any form, weakening the specific contrast developed immediately afterward.
findings.rationale: 독단 specifically denotes the fast, easy poison pill later contrasted with the painful act of severing the heart meridian.
findings.replacement: I can tell just from the fact that they severed their heart meridians instead of taking a poison pill.
findings.source: ‘독단이 아니라 심맥을 끊은 것만 봐도 짐작할 수 있지.’

findings.current: This was the sort of place where all kinds of venomous creatures swarmed even if you simply went on a picnic in the grass outside the Outer Palace.
findings.defect: The established rendering for 독물 is “venomous beasts,” not “venomous creatures.”
findings.rationale: The binding glossary explicitly maps 독물 to “venomous beasts.”
findings.replacement: This was the sort of place where all kinds of venomous beasts swarmed even if you simply went on a picnic in the grass outside the Outer Palace.
findings.source: 당장 외궁 밖의 풀숲으로 피크닉만 가도 온갖 독물들이 우글거리는 동네니까.

findings.defect: The draft makes Yayul Mok declare that the situation is beyond remedy and intensifies 늦었어 with “too,” whereas he is acknowledging that he himself arrived late.
findings.rationale: Jin’s immediate reply, 그래, 늦었지, confirms that Yayul Mok is commenting on his own late arrival; the source does not say “too late.”

summary: Several actionable fidelity issues alter the medical mechanism, assign agency or intent absent from the source, weaken Dark Heaven’s stated role, and change Yayul Mok’s pragmatic meaning.
